signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Set product direction for Quality Control, from customer discovery through release and post-launch learning.
Learn how lenders review closing documents and where those workflows break down.
Separate shared customer needs from one-off requests, then make clear product choices.
Partner with Engineering and Data Science on requirements, trade-offs, and delivery.
Give Implementation, Customer Success, and Sales clear guidance on product decisions.
